description: This file defines the Api class, a data transfer object (DTO) used in the installer utility of OrangeHRM to represent API-related data, including permissions and module details.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing API data, including API identifier, module name, permissions, and associated metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize Api object with name, description, api identifier, module, allowed permissions, and specific permissions.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Static method to create an Api object from provided data array, validating permission structure.
